{{Quote|Welcome to the Third Sun, center of rollicking jollity in sunny Mos Taike|[[D'Mayna Stallaphalat]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The '''Third Sun Cantina''', also known as the '''Mos Taike Tavern''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] run by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[D'Mayna Stallaphalat]] (aka Stella) in the town of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Stella became a favorite with all the locals, and got to know everyone in the town, and they all came to her cantina. She even allowed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives into her bar.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] took interst in her business, but she eventually convinced him to leave her alone.
